title: Answer
description:
If perfection had come through the earlier priesthood, no other priest would be required. That priesthood did its service and left perfection undone.

When the priesthood changes, the law that tied priesthood to one tribe must change. God’s whole will is not discarded. The rule that installed that tribe cannot stay.

A ruler was promised from Judah. The priest’s office was not given to Judah under the law of the priests. This priest arises from Judah.

The old rule was a commandment about flesh and descent. This priesthood stands by the power of a life that does not end.
